notes.title: Exilium demo version IS AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2197240/Exilium/]Exilium Demo[/url] version is available!

It means that we’re one step closer to the release.

We hope you will enjoy your experience and have a great time. 
We would be glad if you could share your Exilium experience in the community center [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2197240/discussions/0/5943120984231335666/]at THIS link[/url]. We will use this information and your impressions to make Exilium better.

Thank you for reading to the end.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2197240/Exilium/

You can send your cooperation and Exilium improvement proposals to our e-mail:
lonchdev@gmail.com

Thank you for being with us!

notes.title: Resolved the problem with multiplayer for two players.
notes.content: Great news. We have long dealt with the problem of multiplayer. Resolved the problem with multiplayer for two players.

notes.title: Multiplayer Update
notes.content:
Dear players. We apologize to you. Due to the large number of comments concerning problems with the multiplayer, we are temporarily blocking the game in multiplayer mode until an update. Now, you can only go through the single player version of the game. Have a great game!

See you soon.

lonch.me team
